headline: Colombia Ends Decades-Long Fomag Contract with Fiduprevisora
summary: The Colombian Ministry of Education announced the end of a 36-year contract between Fomag and Fiduprevisora, initiating a new administrative phase for teachers.
why: Changes in government procurement and public fund management affect institutional operations and state-contracted service providers.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Termination of long-standing government contracts alters public sector administrative arrangements.
